product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle measures digital friction in websites and apps, connects performance and customer experience to conversion and revenue, and helps digital teams prioritize and validate fixes.

pricing_page.notes: The public packages page lists plans and custom pricing, even though most monetary price amounts are not shown.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn showed 21 employees. Applying the provided bands, this is outside any listed band; however the requested band is inferred as 11-20 only if counting is off—correction: available 21 employees indicates 21-50. Set to 21-50.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Glen Allen, Virginia, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Company press material and company blog report the company was founded in 2011.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index is mainly product announcements, customer stories and marketing/web-performance material; it does not show at least two qualifying engineering-authored build/infrastructure posts.

public_docs.notes: Public help center and documentation category are available.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page points to a LinkedIn jobs board but did not expose current job titles in the available page content, so an AI/ML role could not be confirmed or ruled out.

model_provider.notes: The MCP material names compatible assistant clients, not the underlying model providers. The public subprocessor list names AWS, Google, and Snowflake but does not identify an AI model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page provides a process to request the SOC-2 report and ISO27001 information; these are publicly named certifications/attestations.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $857,750 round closing in November 2014, but the latest-round stage/date/amount from the available funding database record could not be reliably established.

raised_18mo.notes: The public company funding announcement located is from 2014, and the funding profile reported rounds but did not show a recent round; no funding within the 18-month window was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company careers page links to LinkedIn jobs, but current job titles were not available in the page content, so sales-development or account-executive hiring cannot be ruled out.

launched_6mo.notes: The product-announcement index shows the new MCP connector in August 2026 and the Revenue Assurance platform introduction in July 2026, within six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The team page lists leadership but does not provide tenure/start dates, and no dated departure or appointment announcement was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable support/documentation pages did not name CRM or sales/marketing systems.
